earlierDestinationSaved: Earlier destination edits saved; newer edits need saving.
connectedNotice: Connected to GitHub for this session.
reviewGuidance: Review the selected content before downloading or publishing.
stale: The workspace or publishing destination has changed since this edition was prepared. Prepare a new edition, or explicitly review this retained edition for publishing.
changedInputs: {count} retained figure(s) have newer or unavailable inputs. Review whether those historical results are appropriate for this edition.
editedFigures: {count} figure(s) differ from their retained calculations. Review the edited values and presentation.
confirm: I have reviewed this website and its media for sharing.
confirmRequired: Please review the website and confirm it is ready to share.
repositoryChanges: {destination} will be updated with the reviewed website. Unrelated files and existing Git history are preserved. Only files previously published here by this workspace can be updated or removed.
pagesSource: GitHub Pages will serve {branch} from the repository root. Future uploads use the same branch.
destinationConfirm: I approve these repository changes for this website.
preparationGuidance: Preparation keeps a private copy of the selected edition. Review it before downloading or uploading.
empty: No prepared editions yet. Use Review website in Publishing or Preview & export in the website editor.
workspaceChanged: The workspace changed. Reopen Website preparations.
waitForMedia: Wait for the media copy to finish, then preview.
draftChanged: The draft changed while preparing the preview. Preview again to include the latest edits.
selectionGuidance: Expand a record to choose content for this edition. Your saved records stay unchanged. Unchanged records keep their public selection.
selectionChartBoundary: A public chart reveals plotted values. Exact data tables and CSV downloads start off and require a separate choice.
selectionPrivacyDetail: Visible marks, labels and SVG can reveal plotted values even when downloads are off. Original datasets, analysis files and other source artifacts are never included automatically.
selectionData: Include exact data table and CSV for {title}
selectionNoRecords: No records are selected. The edition can still include selected website pages and projects.

unresolvedReferences.one: {count} research reference is unavailable in this edition. Its private label and destination are excluded; current text is never substituted for a missing historical revision.
unresolvedReferences.other: {count} research references are unavailable in this edition. Their private labels and destinations are excluded; current text is never substituted for a missing historical revision.

websiteFolderHint: Leave blank to publish at the repository root, or use a folder such as lab/field-notes. The public website URL, if supplied, must point to this folder.
ownershipHint: Each upload updates the selected branch (main by default). Review the exact file changes before publishing. Conflicting files are never overwritten; choose another folder or resolve the conflict first.
conflictGuidance: Publishing is blocked because these paths contain other files or a previously published file was changed or removed outside Observanda. Restore the expected published files or choose another website folder, then prepare and review the destination again.
referenceGuidance: Select an exact referenced revision to add it to this edition. Review its text and content choices first. Its URL stays stable in later editions that include this same revision.
revisionUnavailable: This reference has no retained record revision available here.
availabilityGuidance: Shown only when this reference is excluded. Write only what readers may see; do not include private names, paths or identifiers.
noReferences: No research references in this selected content.
legacyGuidance: Preserve old chapter addresses and fragments with a static contents page linking to individual records. Mappings are reused in future editions. Each destination must be selected for publication; an exact revision must be included or still be the selected current revision. Duplicate or unavailable mappings block preparation.
legacyFragment: Old fragment (without #; blank for the whole page)
legacyInvalid: Enter a relative .html path, page title and public label for each mapping. Use one or more mappings per page.
rollbackReview: Review this retained edition for publishing
rollbackGuidance: This publishes the retained files exactly as reviewed, replacing the currently published edition at the destination shown below. It does not restore or edit your workspace. Review the repository changes again before publishing.
rollbackConfirm: I approve replacing the published website with this retained edition.
sshConfirmed: Remote release verified; live website verification is separate
deploymentStopping: Stopping; remote changes may already have happened.
deploymentRepositoryOnly: Repository files verified. Pages settings were left unchanged.
deploymentPagesRequired: Files are pushed; GitHub Pages setup needs attention in the destination settings.
deploymentsGuidance: Uploads use the reviewed edition. Stopping does not undo uploaded files, a pushed branch or a switched SSH release. Resume to reconcile an uncertain result. After a restart, reconnect GitHub in Integrations; SSH continues using your verified SSH access.
deploymentsEmpty: No deployments yet. Review a prepared edition to start an upload.
liveVerified: The live website is verified: all {count} files match the reviewed release; {removed} removed URLs return not found.
liveFailed: The latest live check failed. The website is not verified; check the public URL and retry.
livePending: Remote publication confirmed; live website verification is separate.
liveManifestOnly: The manifest was checked previously. Verify again to check every file.
liveRetrying: Waiting for GitHub Pages to serve the reviewed edition. Automatic checks will retry while this page is open.
legacyGeneratedPath: This path is already used by a generated page. Choose another path.
legacyAmbiguousPath: More than one legacy page uses this path.
legacyAmbiguousFragment: More than one mapping uses this fragment on the same page.
legacyUnmappedTarget: The selected edition does not include this target or exact revision. Review the mapping and edition selection.
liveRemoved: A removed URL is still accessible or its absence could not be established. Check the host and caches, then retry.
liveMissing: The server did not return this file successfully.
liveMismatch: The served bytes do not match the reviewed edition.
liveUnavailable: The request failed or timed out.
liveManifestInvalid: The served manifest or file inventory does not match this deployment.
liveProgress: Live check: {done} of {total} files and removed URLs checked.
liveStopped: Live check stopped. Resume restarts verification against the current served bytes.
copyFallback: Automatic copying is unavailable. Select and copy the text above.
